fusions.name: Closing Lattice
fusions.desc: Bars of plaited hair rise in a ring and close, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 1.2 seconds and holding them [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: No Way Out
fusions.desc: Bars of plaited hair shut around a target up to 5 tiles away, dealing 28 damage and leaving it [Inescapable] for 10 seconds. Bosses and elites take a further 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Woven Palisade
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of plaited hair 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Bars That Grab
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything but fire, a strand lashes out at the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 7 damage. Once every 6 seconds. Anything you strike moves 25% slower for 2 seconds.
